fusions.name: Wrist Lock
fusions.desc: Twists the target's weapon hand, which deals 12 damage, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Damped] and 5% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Flicked Coin
fusions.desc: Flicks a coin off your thumb that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles, with a 20% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Nimble Work
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Busy Fingers
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
